limits: RSS and auxiliary maxima are sampled lower bounds, not simultaneous absolute peaks. Missing measurements remain unknown.
CPU percentiles omit intervals lacking adjacent identities or readings. Startup and brief boundaries have insufficient CPU intervals.
L1 committed 95991 of 96000 generated states; L2 committed 53403 of 76800. Percentiles cover observed states only.
L2 recorded 104 read issues during the burst. This baseline does not claim stress correctness, no OOM under all loads, or 24-hour acceptance.
Native sampler overhead was excluded from the application tree and was not separately time-series measured.
Synthetic visibility and headless windows do not verify native focus, physical tray, VoiceOver, or visible animation.
The initial full run remains incomplete; accepted scenarios were combined without changing the product, fixtures, probes or native sampler.
